manager.description: Plans the work, assigns each task to an employee tier, reviews results as the general viewer, and issues rework.

efficient.description: Cheap and fast. Mechanical edits, searches, log/file reading, formatting, running given commands, simple tests.

default.description: Normal engineering work. Implementing scoped features and fixes with tests, focused code review, diagnosis with clear leads.

advanced.description: Hard problems only. Concurrency/locking, security, cross-module design, root causes nobody has found, adversarial verification of risky changes.

notes: Edit this file, then run: python -I ~/.claude/skills/boss/sync_agents.py. Tier names are free-form; add or rename tiers here and the sync script regenerates ~/.claude/agents/boss-employee-<tier>.md. Keep top-tier models (opus/fable/astra) at maxConcurrent <= 3 (global CLAUDE.md rule).
